calculation.description: Three-session contrarian return normalized by 20-session volatility, with magnitude modulated by the contemporaneous five-session VIX change relative to its trailing 60-session distribution. All inputs are known at decision date t and forecast next-session close-to-close return. VIX is observation-only and never tradable.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC in 2020-2022 (0.04677), 2023-2024 (0.02574), and 2025-2026 (0.04779). Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
